[RDSC.14.4.1] The `DocString` atom records the docstring of one declaration —
a schema, slot, or rule — as **structured, node-associated** metadata,
independently strippable from the full-source `DsSource`. It buys what `DsSource`
cannot: a source-stripped library `.dsc` that still ships its documented API
surface, and re-parse-free tooling (IDE hovers, doc-gen, debugger node
annotations).
